notes: Reviewed environment-variable changes for the shared API Lambdas, one section per environment. guarded-{staging,production}-lambda-config.yml inspect reports the state of every listed key against the live configuration; apply is refused unless every listed key still holds its recorded live value (or already holds the intended one). set: keys to write, each with the exact live value (from; null when the key is absent) and the intended value (to). unset: keys to remove, each with the exact live value. Keys the section does not list are carried over untouched; nothing outside Environment.Variables is ever sent. Credential-like keys (SECRET, PASSWORD, TOKEN, KEY, CREDENTIAL) are refused in set: those stay in NoEcho template parameters. A credential-like key may be removed only as unset KEY: { "from_sha256": "<sha256 of the exact live value>" }, copied from the inspect's live_credential_sha256; its value is never recorded here. status pending_inspect means the section has not been filled from an inspect run yet; a filled section is a reviewed plan change. Filling a section never deploys. After a verified apply the section is recorded applied and emptied by a record PR so the next change starts from a fresh inspect.
